scientific_question: Does an anytime-valid controller admit one fixed DLO3 discrepancy field on the previously supported DEFORM-to-PyElastica transfer axis and subsequently revoke it when the same field becomes harmful after a shift to DLO4/DLO5?

stream.loss_cap_origin: Predeclared conservative geometric scale for a retrospective behavior audit; not selected to authorize a fresh target claim.

mechanism_supported_only_if: the controller first admits during the PyElastica panel
the controller subsequently revokes after the DLO4 shift
the controller never reconstructs the physical fallback
the guarded post-shift candidate exposure is strictly smaller than unguarded exposure
the guarded post-shift cumulative regret is strictly smaller than unguarded post-shift cumulative regret
registered_decision.negative_outcome: If admission or revocation does not occur under the frozen stream, retain only the theorem and controlled-simulation result. Do not tune cap, margins, betting fractions, ordering, or artifact selection.

claim_boundary: A pass is a retrospective real-data mechanism replay showing admission followed by revocation for one fixed coefficient field across one registered backend-to-operator shift. It does not establish prospective anytime validity, arbitrary shift detection, universal transport, zero harm, physical correctness, deployment safety, or state of the art.
